summary: Iter17 — Funder Impact Dashboard: end-to-end tested BOTH backend and frontend. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass covering GET /api/admin/impact/summary (403 unauth, 200 with admin JWT, correct shape), grant-config POST (0 → cost_per_resident=0; 15000 → cost_per_resident=15000/unique_residents), volunteer_contact analytics increments (headline.volunteer_conversions +1, reach.volunteer_clicks +1, hours=conv*4, value=hours*15), geography contains 'BL6' outward-code only, PDF endpoint (403 unauth, 200 with header auth, 200 with ?token= query auth, %PDF-1.4 header, short PDF byte-size < full). Frontend: admin logged in via ComingSoon cs-admin-login-open flow, navigated to /admin, nav-impact-dashboard button present and clicked → /admin/impact loads with all 8 tiles (unique-residents, orgs-live, events-live, volunteer-conv, event-views, org-views, shares, cost-per-resident) + social value card + grant-config-card + geographic reach bar (BL6 shown, count 42) + top orgs panel. Window select 90→7 refetched. Refresh button reloaded. Grant save (20000) → toast 'Grant configuration saved' + cost tile updated to £3,333.33. PDF download intercepted (blackrod-now-impact-short-2026-07-26.pdf). Anchor hrefs for impact-download-short/full both include token= query param. 11 volunteer-contact buttons on /volunteering → click fires POST /api/analytics/track (200). Grant reset to 0 at end (idempotent).
action_items: Two bugs found and auto-fixed by testing agent (see updated_files) — please review the fixes.

Bug 1 (BACKEND CRITICAL, fixed): AnalyticsEvent model Literal (server.py line 213-221) did NOT include 'volunteer_contact', but AnalyticsTrackReq accepts it. POST /api/analytics/track with kind='volunteer_contact' 500'd with pydantic ValidationError. Fix: added 'volunteer_contact' to AnalyticsEvent.kind Literal.

Bug 2 (FRONTEND CRITICAL, fixed): Cards.jsx line 244 had `// eslint-disable-next-line import/no-unresolved` referencing a rule not present in project ESLint config → webpack overlay 'Compiled with problems' blocked the entire app UI. Also frontend was sending `entity_type: 'volunteer'` but AnalyticsTrackReq only accepts entity_type in {'org','event'} → would 422. Fix: removed the eslint-disable line AND removed entity_type from the trackAnalytics payload.
critical_code_review_comments: AnalyticsEvent and AnalyticsTrackReq Literals were out of sync — the model refactor when adding volunteer_contact missed one side. Consider a shared enum or constant list to prevent recurrence.

The webpack ESLint overlay blocked the entire ComingSoon page silently in preview (user couldn't click Admin login). Configure eslint plugins consistently, or set eslint-webpack-plugin to warning-only in dev.
server.py still 4250+ lines — long overdue for module split (carried from iter14–16).

Cards.jsx uses dynamic `import('@/lib/api')` inside a click handler for a fire-and-forget analytics call — works but is unusual. Recommend importing `api` at the top of the module (it's already a static module) to avoid webpack chunk splitting overhead and stale imports.
PDF variant=short is functional but only ~10% smaller than full — consider skipping full geography/top-orgs tables in short variant to make the difference more meaningful for board summaries.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Impact dashboard flows + PDF download + volunteer analytics tracking verified)

rca_of_the_issue: AnalyticsEvent.kind Literal (server.py) and AnalyticsTrackReq.kind Literal are duplicated definitions. When adding 'volunteer_contact' the developer added it only to the request model, so validation on the request succeeded but insertion into the DB via AnalyticsEvent(...) 500'd. Reproduction: POST /api/analytics/track {kind:'volunteer_contact', entity_id:'x'} → 500 Internal Server Error with pydantic ValidationError in stack trace. Mitigation: share one Literal/Enum between the two models.
